name: show-more-list
title: Show more list
description: A list that shows its first few items and a Show 7 more reviews button for the rest, with focus kept on the button and the count announced politely.
docs: Pass items and renderItem, or the drawn items as children when you are in a Server Component, where a function cannot be passed. noun names what the button reveals, as a string or as { one, other } when a single item can be left; step reveals in chunks. It works on data already in memory and makes no request. New items ease in unless reduced motion is on.
